coverage.population: Interested first-year senior secondary students from9selected public schools in BeninCity,EdoState; schools required computerlabs.
coverage.omitted: Noninterested students, schools without computerlabs, endline nonrespondents and incomplete regressioncases.
coverage.missingness: Substantial differential endline attrition; no student microdata inpack. Authors discuss Lee bounds and weighting checks.

uncertainty: Published robustSE0.068 for each coefficient. Randomized intervention among interested students; differential attrition and selected computer-equipped schools limit interpretation/generalizability. No countrywide effect or AI-alone treatment claim.
limitations: Treatment bundles model access, teachers, curriculum and after-school time.
RegressionN654 differs from759assessment completers due to covariate completecases.
Initially1328randomized students; substantial differential endline attrition.
No longterm followup, otherlanguages, adultliteracy or national population estimate.
Microdata forthcoming; independent fulltrial reproduction unavailable.
